resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or other open-source DFT code)

access.notes: The paper used the proprietary VASP code. An open-source DFT package such as Quantum ESPRESSO can perform LSDA calculations with comparable accuracy.

resources.name: LSDA pseudopotentials for Si and O

access.notes: Standard pseudopotential libraries (e.g., SSSP, PseudoDojo, GBRV) provide LSDA pseudopotentials for silicon and oxygen suitable for solid-state calculations.
The experimental crystal structure of α‑quartz (lattice parameters, space group, and atomic positions) is available from crystallographic databases.
